mission_md:
Cedar County is fictional. This example shows how a campaign publishes **source-linked** findings.

- Request policies, agreements, sharing settings and audit records.
- Preserve originals and cite them by hash.
- Bring reviewed evidence to official meetings.

Read the [engine documentation](https://example.invalid/fictional-docs) for the content model.
about_md:
## Who we are

A fictional group of Cedar County residents. No real agency, person, camera or record is described anywhere on this site.

## How findings are reviewed

Every finding names its classification and confidence and cites source records by SHA-256. Findings marked needs_attorney_review are never rendered.
